output.title: Two-Bedroom Apartment with Balcony and Parking in Esch-sur-Alzette
output.description:
This 78 m² apartment in Esch-sur-Alzette comprises two bedrooms and one bathroom, offering a practical living space within a well-maintained building with elevator access. The living room presents a neutral palette with beige walls and laminate flooring, opening onto a modest balcony that extends the living area outdoors.

The kitchen is arranged in an L-shaped layout featuring white cabinetry and accommodates a small dining table, providing a functional space for everyday meals. Both the living room and kitchen benefit from the apartment's simple and light interior.

A parking space is included with the property, adding convenience for residents. Located in Luxembourg's second-largest city, the apartment offers access to a growing and culturally dynamic area that includes the local university and the Belval district.
